scientific_integrity: The proof uses the exact Weibull-to-log-exponential representation, the local Taylor series of log Gamma, and a smooth fixed-endpoint CDF expansion. The numerical verifier is only a regression check and is not used as an infinite-parameter proof. Originality is supported by source-level comparison, targeted published-record searches, and prior-claim screening, with residual risk retained for older reliability or extreme-value literature under alternate terminology.
scientific_limitations: The result is a large-shape asymptotic for the ordinary one-dimensional Weibull family. It does not determine the smallest finite shape restoring the Gaussian benchmark, prove global monotonicity, or classify every finite-shape crossing.
title: An Apéry correction at the large-shape Weibull one-sigma endpoint
